It is initially sparsely populated with NPCs but after a series of [[secondary quest]]s, it will be filled with all of the [[NPC service]]s that you would expect in a [[town]] (except the [[PvP]]-related NPCs). ==Getting there== This explorable area is only accessible after completing the [[primary quest]] [[Hunted!]], which involves first clearing out the [[Sunspear Sanctuary]] in [[Secure the Refuge]]. After that, it can be entered through any of its five exits. ==Shrines== There are no [[resurrection shrine]]s in this area. ==Quests available== *[[Dunkoro]] **[[Building the Base: Prisoners of War]] So if one player has gained [[Hasahk the Clever]] and another has [[Jehrono]], both will be available. *The [[hero]] NPCs, however, are the other way around - they appear only if every player character has reached their respective point in the storyline. *Because there are no shrines in the area, if all party members die (i.e. due to [[vampiric]] weapons or Health sacrifice), your party will get the "Your party has been defeated" message and must return to the last visited town or outpost. * This area is "underground" and as such does not contribute to the Elonian Cartographer title track. ==Trivia== {{gw2w|Old Command Post|3=}} *This is the only [[explorable area]] in the game that has as many [[NPC service]]s as most [[town]]s. {{Explorable areas in Kourna}} [[de:Kommandostelle]]
